messages.content: You are a BPMN 2.0 modelling expert. Produce a complete BPMN 2.0 XML model for the process described by the user. Output ONLY the XML, nothing else.

The EC tells the INQ about the change of his master data. The INQ notifies the IP of the change. The IP checks whether the master data can be changed at the desired time. The IP confirmes the changes of the INQ or the IP rejectes the changes of the INQ.

                  id="Definitions_MasterDataChange"

  <!-- COLLABORATION -->

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_IP_Confirm_to_INQ" name="Confirmation" sourceRef="Task_IP_Confirm" targetRef="Task_INQ_ReceiveResponse" />
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_IP_Reject_to_INQ" name="Rejection" sourceRef="Task_IP_Reject" targetRef="Task_INQ_ReceiveResponse" />

  <!-- PROCESS: Energy Customer (EC) -->

    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_EC_InformINQ" name="Inform INQ about master data change">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_EC_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_EC_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_EC" name="INQ informed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_EC_2</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EC_1" sourceRef="Start_EC" targetRef="Task_EC_InformINQ" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EC_2" sourceRef="Task_EC_InformINQ" targetRef="End_EC" />
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_INQ" name="Inquiring Party Process" isExecutable="true">

      <bpmn:incoming/>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_INQ_1</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MsgEventDef_INQ_Start" />
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_INQ_NotifyIP" name="Notify IP of data change">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_INQ_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_INQ_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_INQ_ReceiveResponse" name="Receive response from IP">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_INQ_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_INQ_3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_INQ" name="Process completed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_INQ_3</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_INQ_1" sourceRef="Start_INQ_Received" targetRef="Task_INQ_NotifyIP" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_INQ_2" sourceRef="Task_INQ_NotifyIP" targetRef="Task_INQ_ReceiveResponse" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_INQ_3" sourceRef="Task_INQ_ReceiveResponse" targetRef="End_INQ" />
  </bpmn:process>

  <!-- PROCESS: Invoice Party (IP) -->
  <bpmn:process id="Process_IP" name="Invoice Party Process" isExecutable="true">

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_IP_1</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MsgEventDef_IP_Start" />
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_IP_Check" name="Check if data can be changed at desired time">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_IP_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_IP_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CheckResult" name="Change possible at desired time?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_IP_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_IP_Yes</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_IP_No</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_IP_Confirm" name="Confirm changes to INQ">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_IP_Yes</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_IP_3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_IP_Reject" name="Reject changes to INQ">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_IP_No</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_IP_4</bpmn:outgoing>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Join">

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_IP_5</bpmn:outgoing>

      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_IP_5</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_IP_1" sourceRef="Start_IP_Received" targetRef="Task_IP_Check" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_IP_2" sourceRef="Task_IP_Check" targetRef="Gateway_CheckResult" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_IP_3" sourceRef="Task_IP_Confirm" targetRef="Gateway_Join" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_IP_4" sourceRef="Task_IP_Reject" targetRef="Gateway_Join" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_IP_5" sourceRef="Gateway_Join" targetRef="End_IP" />
